stem: The snow-line in Himalayas lies between
expl: The altitude in a particular place above which some snow remains on the ground throughout the year is called snow line. The snow line in the Himalayas has different heights in different parts. On an average it has height of 5500 – 6000m in Northern Part and 4500- 6000m in Sourthern Part of the Himalayas. In this way snow line in Himalayas lies between 4300 m to 6000 m.

stem: Siachen Glacier is situated to the:
expl: Siachen Glacier is located in the Eastern Karakoram range in the Himalayas, and it lies to the North of Nubra Valley. The Siachen glacier (highest battlefield in the world) demarcates central Asia from the Indian subcontinent, and separates Pakistan and China in the region.

stem: Which amongst the following is the largest glacier?
expl: Siachen is the largest glacier in India.According to the textbooks titled as 'Bhautik Bhugol ka Swaroop' written by Savindra Singh, 'Geography of India' written by V.S. Chauhan and Alka Gautam and 'Physical Geography (Introduction to Earth)' written by K. Bharadwaj and 'Bharat Ka Bhugol (Geography of India)' written by Professor Ram Chandra Tiwari, the length of Siachen is 72 km. According to the World Glacier Inventory, the length of Siachen is 76.64 km.

stem: Which is the largest glacier of Trans-Himalayas ?
expl: The Siachen Glacier is located in the Karakoram Range of the Trans-Himalayan region, and it is considered as the largest glacier in this region.This vast geographical region includes major mountain ranges such as the Karakoram, Ladakh, Zanskar, and Kailash etc.

Chaurabari Glacier is located in Garhwal Himalayas region of Uttarakhand. The glacier lies in north of the Kedarnath Temple. Due to melting of glacier, a lake is formed which is named as Gandhi Sarovar Lake.

stem: The rate of melting of Himalayan glaciers is:

options.label: c
options.text: Same as of the glaciers of other parts of the world

options.label: d
options.text: No information is available about the melting rate of Himalayan glaciers

expl: The rate of melting of Himalayan Glaciers is highest in the world. The Gangotri Glacier from where river Ganga originates is melting very fast, due to which it has been reduced to half of its extent in the last 50 years.

stem: Which one of the following glaciers is located in Kumaun region of Uttarakhand ?
expl: Milam Glacier is a major glacier of the Kumaun region in Uttarakhand. Gori Ganga River originates from this glacier.

stem:
Consider the following pairs : Glacier River
1. Bandarpunch : Yamuna
2. Bara Shigri : Chenab
3. Milam : Mandakini
4. Siachen : Nubra
5. Zemu : Manas
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
expl: Mandakini river originates from Chorabari glacier. Zemu Glacier is the largest glacier in the Eastern Himalaya. It is about 26 kilometres in length and is located at the base of Kanchenjunga in the Himalayan region of Sikkim. The Manas River is transboundary river in Himalayan foothills between southern Bhutan & India. It is the most extensive river system in Bhutan. Besides Nubra, Yamuna & Chenab originate from several glaciers, i.e. Siachen, Bandarpunch & Bara Shigri.
